# A policy writing its derived category by hand

`Policy: pol-CATS` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

`category` is read from the folder the record sits in, so writing it here states a second answer. This file sits
directly in `policies/`, and the line claims `security`.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `derived-key` has a document to fire on.

## Clauses

| Id     | Clause                                                       | Alignment |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `ONLY` | **MUST** carry no fault but the hand-written derived key     |           |
